title: RNA-Seq invivo Control (Chow) Diet
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate total cellular RNA
steps.instruction: Extract cellular RNA using the RNeasy® Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalog number 74104) following the kit’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Analyze and quantify the isolated RNA with an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑Seq library
steps.instruction: Use 200 ng of the total RNA to construct libraries with the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs GmbH, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Follow the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit protocol to generate the library.

steps.title: Assess library quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Evaluate the resulting libraries using an Agilent BioAnalyzer to check concentration and fragment size distribution.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq instrument and sequence to obtain approximately 35 million paired‑end reads per library, 100 bp read length.
